mapper.select: SELECT id, couple_id, user_id, title, description, completed, create_time FROM love_wishlist_item WHERE couple_id = #{coupleId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO love_wishlist_item (couple_id, user_id, title, description, completed) VALUES (#{coupleId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE love_wishlist_item SET completed = #{completed} WHERE id = #{id}
